_comment: Hand-declared governor cost tiers per effect kind (backend hardening 6/6). Canonical source of truth for the declared side of predictCostTier. Follows the Phase-3 cost-tier contract: tier 0 = structural (never shed), tier 1 = shed first, tier 2 = quality scalers, tier 3 = cosmetic. These are HAND-DECLARED — they stand in until measured tiers (plan item 5) and the learned cost model (item 11) exist. When an effect registers its own tier at registration time (Phase 3), this file retires.

accum-copy.rationale: accum buffer copy into the composite chain; structural

accum-echo.rationale: multi-tap echoes with memory gate; shed first

accum-fade.rationale: accum feedback fade; shed first per architecture Phase 3

blur.rationale: two separable passes; the most expensive builtin

composite.rationale: final composite; the picture cannot exist without it

displace.rationale: warp distortion, dependent texture read; shed first

edge.rationale: 3x3 convolution but single pass and small kernel; cosmetic

grain.rationale: film grain with aux LUT texture; texture-heavy

invert.rationale: single arithmetic op per pixel; cosmetic

quad.rationale: fullscreen-triangle blit used by still/export path; structural

resolve.rationale: MSAA resolve in the still path; structural

tear.rationale: tear distortion, dependent texture read; shed first
